ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_advantage_square_sum_then_mean
ir.intuition: This loss retains the softplus transformation of the negative log probability difference weighted by the squared advantage gap, but changes the aggregation structure by first summing weighted losses per instance and then averaging over instances. This structure shift emphasizes the total pairwise penalty contribution per instance before normalization across the batch.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_sq = advantage_gap ^ 2
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = softplus(-score_diff) * adv_sq * weight
loss_sum_per_instance = sum(loss grouped by instance)
final_loss = mean(loss_sum_per_instance)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    adv_sq = ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap)
    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    loss_raw = ops.mul(ops.softplus(ops.neg(score_diff)), adv_sq)
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_raw, weight)
    instance_ids = batch.get('instance_id', None)
    if instance_ids is None:
        # No instance grouping, fall back to mean over all pairs
        return ops.mean(weighted_loss)
    else:
        # accumulate loss per instance
        # assuming instance_ids is an integer tensor of shape matching weighted_loss
        unique_ids, inverse_indices = ops.unique(instance_ids, return_inverse=True)
        sum_per_instance = ops.zeros_like(unique_ids, dtype=weighted_loss.dtype)
        sum_per_instance = sum_per_instance.scatter_add(0, inverse_indices, weighted_loss)
        return ops.mean(sum_per_instance)
